candidate_qualification: A routed architecture enters the paired Pareto calculation only if its exact-order and serial-target verification passes, its detailed-route DRC count is zero, and structured route, timing, and scan-net records exist.
primary_physical_metric_selection: Use exact routed scan-net-only length only when every qualified architecture in the pair has an all-exclusive Q/SI net extraction; otherwise use scan HPWL for every architecture in that pair and label it a proxy.
within_design_replication: All five predeclared physical seeds complete, pair placements distinct, and at least four of five pairs meet the predeclared practical-conflict thresholds.
across_design_replication: At least two nontrivial designs satisfy within-design replication.
simple_heuristic_sufficiency: Nearest-neighbor P trivially dominates when it is the sole Pareto architecture in every completed seed of a design. G8 passes only when two designs each have at least four completed seeds with a non-P architecture on the frontier.
bootstrap: Paired within-design median percentile bootstrap, deterministic seed 0 and 10000 resamples, only after all five physical seeds complete; descriptive and no population claim.
phase1_gate: G5 G6 G7a G7b G8 all true; incomplete campaigns never count as GO.
